newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Dec industrial price index rises 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada Dec industrial price index rises 0.4 pct.

text.p: Statistics Canada on Wednesday issued the following economic indicators for December.
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
The IPPI reflects the prices producers receive as goods leave their plants.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that the overall index would rise 0.4 percent in December from November.
